nodes.title: The ?tx= switch checked on production after release 23 (377f1a3), one browser device at 360 x 740, n = 1 walk: landing on /?tx=a stores the choice; /start (no query) then renders set-up with data-tx=a on a light surface, the title in Literata 600 (loaded), paper background rgb(246,243,236); /start?tx=off stores off and no themed root remains. Before the fix (release 22, 4 routes) 0 of 4 kept the choice. The CI browser job on this commit logged 16 mirror-resolve failures and still ran its 146 tests, so the install fallback (or a late apt recovery) held.
